title: Hello, DuckDB + polars
text:
Querying a DataFrame with SQL

import duckdb
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "species": ["adelie", "gentoo", "chinstrap", "adelie", "gentoo"],
    "bill_mm": [38.8, 47.5, 48.8, 39.2, 46.1],
})
avg_bills = duckdb.sql(
    "SELECT species, avg(bill_mm) AS avg_bill FROM df GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg_bill"
).pl()
avg_bills
